response.justification: The candidate is a strong senior software engineer with deep open-source involvement, Linux experience, and broad full-stack expertise, but he falls short on the role's core requirements: German proficiency is listed as 'Basic' against a hard C1 minimum, and the resume shows no formal team leadership, people management, or client-facing consulting/architecture advisory experience expected of a Head of Development. Python and UML are also absent from his skill set. He fits a staff/senior IC profile rather than an executive-level tech leadership role.
strengths: Extensive hands-on development experience (18+ years) across web, mobile, embedded, and high-throughput systems
Strong open-source track record and community engagement (GISCollective founder, D-lang libraries, conference talks, workshops)
Solid Linux, DevOps, and infrastructure experience with a testing/craftsmanship mindset relevant to quality-focused consulting
concerns: German at 'Basic' level, far below the required C1 minimum
No demonstrated formal leadership, team management, or project management responsibility in any role
No UML or Python listed, and limited evidence of client advisory, requirements management, or security/compliance work
